name: Free limits and StoreKit entitlements
userOutcome: A free user sees the real daily limit, while an eligible user can purchase or restore products and receive only verified entitlements.
productionDataSource: StoreKit 2 Product and verified Transaction entitlements, plus the persisted AppSettings daily scan counter.
errorBehavior: Store failures show specific retryable messages. Cancellation shows no error. Pending purchases are not reported as active. Missing settings fail the free quota closed until a persisted row binds.
accessibilityRequirements: Selected subscription and locked template state are announced
Busy purchase and restore controls are disabled
Price, renewal, restore, terms, and privacy information remain reachable
prohibitedBehavior: Do not grant entitlement from an unverified transaction
Do not compile mock purchases or force-Pro flags into Release
Do not report restore success when AppStore.sync fails
acceptanceTests: Release-binary audit for debug purchase symbols and launch arguments
StoreKit sandbox purchase, pending, cancel, restore, template-only restore, refund, and offline checks
